content.text: No exclusivity obligation binds Client anywhere in the document; the License section expressly preserves Client's freedom to use alternatives.

input.quote: Notwithstanding the foregoing, Client is not obligated to utilize the License and is free to acquire, develop, license or otherwise utilize any other hardware, software system, design, formula, procedure or trade secret to provide software and services similar to the ones provided by TrueLink hereunder
input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation on Client, so it sits at our preferred position. Section 2(a) grants Client only a non-exclusive licence and expressly confirms Client "is not obligated to utilize the License and is free to acquire, develop, license or otherwise utilize any other hardware, software system, design, formula, procedure or trade secret" for similar software and services (subject only to TrueLink's IP and Section 10 confidentiality). The only sourcing-style covenant, Section 3(i) ("Client shall order TrueLink a credit report on each borrower for which an underwriting approval is requested through a System using the Interface"), is conditioned on Client's voluntary use of the Interface and therefore is not exclusivity given the express freedom to use alternatives. The Section 8(d) reference to the Non-Competition Agreement restricts TrueLink's use of Credit Data rather than binding Client's procurement, and the "solely and exclusively" language in Section 12 is a forum provision, not exclusive dealing. No redline required.
